name: @repo/plugin-web-board-core
description: Board (Kanban) core module for XAI Web Console — canonical Board/Card/List schema (DESIGN.md §9.3) + Kanban view + 10-color list-color palette (tokens.css OKLCH; no hard-coded hex) + native HTML5 cross-list DnD with atomic-move + in-row add-card + add-list composers + bilingual rendering + persistence via usePref on xai_boards_v2 + xai_active_board.
